senses.gloss: m. (v. foreg.) something solid, whence the solid part, flank. Targ. II, Esth. I, 2.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 23b">B. Mets. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>אי דדפנא אי דא׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>או דדפקא או דא׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3) whether from the ribs or from the flank.
<cite ref="Chullin 42b:7">Ḥull. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בוקא דא׳</he> the thickest part of the flank (the thigh, hip).—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:8">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>חדא דלי א׳</he> one (goose) lifted up its thigh (leg).—Pl. <cite ref="I00154"><he>אַטְמֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 8a:11">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דקיימי לקורבנא</he> solid pieces (roast) intended for a present.
<cite ref="Chullin 97b:3">Ḥull. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו אַטְמָהָתָא</he> those solid pieces of the thigh.
<cite ref="Eruvin 57b">Erub. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דשורא</he> ed. (Ms. <he>אטמאתא</he>) flanks (projecting parts) of a wall. V. <cite ref="A01221"><he>אִיטְמָא</he></cite>.
